exploration: epsilon greedy, linear 1.0 -> 0.05 over 60000 steps (DQN/TD3/DDPG); softmax sampling (PPO/SAC)

notes.d_ref_ms: PROVISIONAL: one measured 44-step Min-Latency episode gives D_sum = 5665 ms; 6000 ms is used as the fixed reference and must be re-derived from the Train Min-Latency baseline before Stage 17-D, then frozen for all algorithms.
notes.gamma: Stage-16 value. The paper objective is the undiscounted D_sum; see docs/16 for the analysis. Do not change without review.
notes.failure_penalty: 0.0 keeps the reward free of extra shaping; premature stops are already penalised by the absence of the +1 terminal bonus.
